ref.description: A unique reference hash for the `OrderRefund`.

order.description: The unique reference hash for the parent Forage `Order`.

funding_type.description:
A string that represents the type of tender. One of:

- `benefit`
- `credit_payfac`
- `credit_tpp`
- `ebt_cash`
- `ebt_snap`
- `wic`

status.description:
The status of the `OrderRefund`. One of:

- `canceled`: The `OrderRefund` has been voided and can’t be changed.

- `expired`: The `OrderRefund` has expired and can’t be used.

- `failed`: The `OrderRefund` failed to process. Check the `receipt.message` field for a description of the error.

- `processing`: The outcome of the `OrderRefund` is pending, and the refund can’t be modified. _This status is not returned if you’re using Forage version `2024-01-08` or higher._

- `requires_confirmation`: The `OrderRefund` requires confirmation before it can be processed. Contact Forage support to confirm this refund.

- `succeeded`: The `OrderRefund` has been successfully processed and will be included in settlement.

last_processing_error.description: The `code` and `message` values corresponding to the most recent [Payments API error](https://docs.joinforage.app/reference/errors#payments-api-errors). Always `null` when the `Payment` is created.

created.description: A UTC timestamp that indicates when this object was created, represented as an [ISO 8601 date-time](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) string.

updated.description: A UTC timestamp that indicates when this object was last modified, represented as an [ISO 8601 date-time](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) string.

tpp_lookup_id.description: The unique identifier from the relevant credit TPP or null for EBT refunds. For Stripe integrations, this is the id of the Refund object on Stripe's backend.

BalanceResponse.description: An object that represents an EBT cardholder's account balance.

id.description: The unique identifier for the balance record.

snap.description: The available SNAP balance in USD on the customer’s EBT Card, represented as a numeric string.

non_snap.description: The available EBT Cash balance in USD on the customer's EBT Card, represented as a numeric string.

updated.description: A UTC timestamp that indicates when the funds in the account last changed, represented as an [ISO 8601 date-time](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) string.

sequence_number.description: A transaction number for this `PaymentMethod`'s most recent balance check. Returned only for POS Terminal transactions; omitted from online merchant balance checks.

ExternalOrderIDField.description:
A unique identifier for the order as created by the merchant or platform (not Forage).

When a merchant or platform passes this order ID to Forage, it persists in each Forage transaction related to the `Order`. This field enables merchants to map order IDs in their system to corresponding Forage `Order` IDs.

**You must build with Forage Version `2023-05-15` or later to use `external_order_id`.** Either pass `2023-05-15` as the `API-Version` header on a per request basis, or set the version for all requests in the Forage dashboard.

MetadataObject.description:
A required object containing merchant-defined key-value pairs to provide additional context for the payment.

Merchants should use this field to store **reference information** relevant to the transaction (for example, order details, system identifiers, or tracking data). This helps link the payment to records within their system.

Pass an empty object (`{}`) if no additional information is available.

> ⚠️ Personally Identifiable Information
>
> **Do not include personally identifiable information (PII)** such as names, emails, or payment details.

OrderRefundRequest.description: This object represents an order refund. It is associated with a previously created OrderPayment object. Funds will be refunded to the PaymentMethod originally charged.

payment.description: A unique reference hash for the Forage `OrderPayment` to be refunded, returned when the [`OrderPayment` was created](https://docs.joinforage.app/reference/create-order-payment).

amount.description:
The amount to be refunded in USD. Does not need to equal the `amount` field of the `OrderPayment`, if a partial refund. Precision is supported to the penny.

The minimum amount that can be refunded is `0.01`.

reason.description: A string that describes why the refund is happening.

merchant_fixed_settlement.description: The fixed amount in USD that should be restored to the merchant from EBT Cash payments prior to splitting by the `platform_fee`. Precision is supported to the penny.

platform_fixed_settlement.description: The fixed amount in USD that should be restored to the platform from EBT Cash payments prior to splitting by the `platform_fee`. Precision is supported to the penny.

ReceiptData.description:
Most of the information that you're required to display to the customer, according to FNS regulations.

This field is `null` if the data that populates the receipt is not yet available.

The total amount paid by the customer is `snap_amount` + `ebt_cash_amount` + `other_amount`. This amount will be settled with the merchant after applying Forage's fees.

ref_number.description:
A unique reference hash for the Forage `Order`, `Payment`, or `Refund` associated with this receipt.

Note: `receipt.ref_number` equals `ref`.

is_voided.description: Whether the transaction associated with this receipt has been voided. If `false`, then the transaction finished processing as expected. If `true`, then the transaction was reversed.

snap_amount.description: The USD amount charged/refunded to the SNAP balance of the EBT Card, represented as a numeric string.

ebt_cash_amount.description: The USD amount charged/refunded to the EBT Cash balance of the EBT Card, represented as a numeric string.

cash_back_amount.description: The USD amount of cash back given to the customer, represented as a numeric string.

other_amount.description: The USD amount charged/refunded to any payment method that is not an EBT Card, represented as a numeric string.

sales_tax_applied.description: The USD amount of taxes charged to the customer’s non-EBT payment instrument, represented as a numeric string.

last_4.description: The last four digits of the EBT Card number.

message.description: A message from the EBT payment network that must be displayed to the EBT cardholder.

transaction_type.description: A constant string that is used to identify the transaction type associated with the receipt.

created.description: A UTC timestamp of when the Forage transaction object was created, represented as an [ISO 8601 date-time](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) string.

sequence_number.description: The terminal transaction sequence number for POS transactions. `null` for online (non-POS) transactions.
